notes: game.json is exactly what the JSON-only export contains: its asset URLs are unchanged, so it can be imported back into the editor as-is. Use files[] below to find the copy of each URL in this archive.
Only assets hosted by indie.fun/modd.io are bundled. Anything a game hotlinks from another site is listed under skipped with the reason "external host" and is still reachable at its original URL.
An export bundles at most 1000 assets and 128 MB, and no single file over 32 MB. Anything left out for those reasons is listed under skipped.
An asset that no longer exists on the asset host is listed under skipped with the reason "fetch failed". The export does not fail on it, a game that lost a sprite years ago is still worth exporting.
